title: Should you still go to psychology interviews when you have job offers?

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外，还能赚到更多的钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和持续收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将自己的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，例如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家学员完成了他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属推广链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需支付任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场团体验导、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客陪伴在侧，你将踏上《有志心理学家播客》（由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持）的征程。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有志心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: If you're watching on YouTube, you might well notice this is part of the Paulie Wing series where I've broken my arm.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，你可能会注意到这是“断臂侠”系列的一部分，我最近摔断了胳膊。

sentences.en: Why not subscribe and like this video and maybe think about dropping me a comment in as well to tell me what your favourite episode of the podcast has been so far.
sentences.zh: 为什么不订阅并给这个视频点个赞呢？或许还可以给我留个评论，告诉我到目前为止你最喜欢播客的哪一集。

sentences.en: As I record this, we are in the middle, coming towards the end of the doctorate in clinical psychology application season for this spring.
sentences.zh: 在我录制这期节目的时候，今年春季的临床心理学博士申请季正处于中期，且即将接近尾声。

sentences.en: Given that it's such a competitive industry and that the places are so highly sought after, then it's understandable that emotions can run high from time to time,
sentences.zh: 鉴于这是一个竞争如此激烈的行业，并且名额备受追捧，因此情绪有时会有些激动，这也是可以理解的，

sentences.en: if not much of the time.
sentences.zh: 甚至很多时候都是如此。

sentences.en: And recently I'd seen a post on Twitter that had said, can those who have offers already for the declinside and still have interviews coming up,
sentences.zh: 最近我在推特上看到一条帖子，上面说：“那些已经拿到博士项目录用通知、但接下来还有面试的人，

sentences.en: at least consider just accepting one.
sentences.zh: 能不能至少考虑接受其中一个offer？

sentences.en: So others on reserve lists for interviews can at least have a chance of getting at least one offer without having to wait another year whilst being poor.
sentences.zh: 好让面试候补名单上的其他人至少有机会拿到哪怕一个offer，而不用在贫困中再苦等一年。”

sentences.en: So I hear you.
sentences.zh: 我听到你们的心声了。

sentences.en: It's very, very difficult if you are on a reserve list and if you feel like this affects another year of your development and your opportunities.
sentences.zh: 如果你身处候补名单，并且觉得这会影响你未来一年的发展和机会，那确实是非常、非常艰难的。

sentences.en: But also, I think it's worth saying that the people who have interviews and even those who have offers have still earned the right to attend those interviews.
sentences.zh: 但同时，我认为也值得指出的是，那些拿到面试甚至拿到offer的人，同样是通过努力才赢得了参加这些面试的权利。

sentences.en: So today we're going to be looking at whether it's OK to still attend interviews for any psychology profession or area if you already have a job offer.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们要探讨的是，如果你已经有了一份工作offer，是否还能继续参加任何心理学职业或领域的面试。

sentences.en: I'll be guiding you through a few of my thoughts, feelings, insights and reflections on this.
sentences.zh: 我将引导大家了解我对此的一些想法、感受、见解和反思。

sentences.en: But if you've got some of your own, I would love you to come and tell me what you think to this.
sentences.zh: 但如果你有自己的看法，我很乐意听听你的想法。

sentences.en: Come over to the aspiring psychologist community brackets free group on Facebook and let me know what you think.
sentences.zh: 来Facebook的“有志心理学家社区”（括号内为免费群组）告诉我你的想法吧。

sentences.en: And if you're watching on YouTube, let me know in the comments.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，请在评论区告诉我。

sentences.en: So generally speaking, when going to interviews for probably non-psychology roles or maybe even if it's a psychology private practice role or private institution role.
sentences.zh: 通常来说，当去参加非心理学职位的面试，或者甚至是心理学私人诊所或私立机构职位的面试时，

sentences.en: One of the advantages about going to interview when you already have a job offer is that you might be able to use that for salary negotiation.
sentences.zh: 在你已经拿到工作offer的情况下参加面试的一个好处是，你或许可以利用它来作为薪资谈判的筹码。

sentences.en: Clearly in NHS bandings, that's probably not going to work.
sentences.zh: 显然，在NHS（英国国家医疗服务体系）的薪级架构中，这可能行不通。

sentences.en: But one reason you might want to do that is if you're applying to a course in the London waiting area where the salary is slightly higher.
sentences.zh: 但你可能想这么做的一个原因，是你申请的是伦敦补贴区的课程，那里的薪水略高一些。

sentences.en: But of course, that is done for a reason.
sentences.zh: 当然，这样做也是有原因的。

sentences.en: So that is done because, of course, living in and around central London is more expensive.
sentences.zh: 之所以这么做，当然是因为住在伦敦市中心及周边地区的开销更大。

sentences.en: But if you've already committed that you'll be commuting, then you may want to consider doing that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你已经决定要通勤，那么你可能会考虑这样做。

sentences.en: But of course, it is likely your costs for commuting might well be higher as well.
sentences.zh: 不过当然，你的通勤成本很可能也会更高。

sentences.en: So I think it's fair to say that generally speaking, in what is largely an NHS industry for assistant psychologists, but not exclusively, of course,
sentences.zh: 因此我认为可以公平地说，总的来说，在主要（但不完全是）属于NHS体制的助理心理学家行业中，

sentences.en: it's unlikely that you'd be wanting to attend that interview to think about using it for salary negotiation.
sentences.zh: 你不太可能会为了把它当作薪资谈判的筹码而去参加面试。

sentences.en: But of course, not impossible.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这也不是完全不可能。

sentences.en: Another reason you might choose to still attend is to use it as an opportunity for gaining experience.
sentences.zh: 你选择继续参加面试的另一个原因，是把它当作一个积累经验的机会。

sentences.en: Perhaps all of your interviews in the past have been remote interviews if you've done them over the last few years.
sentences.zh: 如果你过去几年参加过的面试都是远程面试，那么也许你所有的面试经验都来自线上。

sentences.en: So perhaps this is an in-person interview and you'd really like to see what this university or employer is going to be like.
sentences.zh: 所以也许这是一场线下实地面试，你真的很想看看这所大学或雇主究竟是什么样的。

sentences.en: And often getting a feel for what the parking is like, what the traffic is like around the area, whether you'd feel safe there,
sentences.zh: 通常可以亲身感受一下停车情况、周边的交通状况、你是否会在那里感到安全，

sentences.en: whether you feel like you like aspects of the interview or the course relating to the physical environment and the people that you meet.
sentences.zh: 以及你是否喜欢面试或课程中与物理环境和所遇到的人相关的各个方面。

sentences.en: It might be even meeting people on reception and that they're so lovely that they just make your day and make you feel like you're being put at ease.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是遇到前台接待人员，他们是那么友善，直接让你的一天都变得美好，让你感到轻松自在。

sentences.en: I know I've spoken in the past about the buffets and the fact that I was given herbal tea at one of the interviews that I attended.
sentences.zh: 我知道我过去曾谈到过自助餐，以及我在参加过的一场面试中被提供过花草茶。

sentences.en: And those for me were really small factors that made me feel like it was a closely aligned course for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这些都是非常小的细节，却让我觉得这是一门与我高度契合的课程。

sentences.en: And when I've attended psychology assistant interviews in the past, one was in Nottingham and one was in Birmingham and the parking was atrocious, really, really bad.
sentences.zh: 当我过去参加助理心理学家面试时，一场在诺丁汉，一场在伯明翰，那里的停车位简直糟透了，真的非常非常糟糕。

sentences.en: It meant I had to leave my car on a side street and then walk.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我不得不把车停在小街上，然后步行过去。

sentences.en: And so that was perhaps not going to be ideal in the longer term.
sentences.zh: 所以从长远来看，这可能并不是最理想的。

sentences.en: But sometimes we can only know that when we've walked a mile in the shoes to that interview.
sentences.zh: 但有时，只有当我们真正亲自走过那段路去参加面试时，我们才能体会到这一点。

sentences.en: And so also it's worth saying always when you're going somewhere that you're not quite sure what's going to be the deal.
sentences.zh: 所以值得一提的是，当你去一个不太确定具体情况的地方时，

sentences.en: Speaking of shoes,
sentences.zh: 说到鞋子，

sentences.en: it might also be an idea when attending interviews in person to take a pair of shoes that are comfortable in your bag so that if it does involve a long walk from a train station or a bus stop or from where you've parked your car,
sentences.zh: 参加线下面试时，在包里备一双舒适的鞋子也是个不错的想法，这样如果从火车站、公交车站或停车的地方需要走很长的路，

sentences.en: if you've driven, that you can do so in comfort so that you're not limping into your interview when you do get there.
sentences.zh: 如果你是开车的话，你就可以舒适地走过去，这样当你到达面试地点时，就不会一瘸一拐的了。

sentences.en: Having recently been in central London trying to get somewhere on time for something that I needed to look rather smart for,
sentences.zh: 由于我最近刚去过伦敦市中心，赶着去一个需要我看起来十分精干的场合，

sentences.en: I would also suggest that it might be advantageous if you can afford it to at least get an Uber or a taxi when you're attending the interview.
sentences.zh: 我还要建议，如果你的经济条件允许，去参加面试时至少叫辆Uber或出租车可能会更有优势。

sentences.en: Because arriving in a big sweaty mess and feeling like you ruined your outfit is also not a good look.
sentences.zh: 因为满头大汗、狼狈不堪地到达，并且觉得自己把精心搭配的衣服都弄毁了，这同样不是个好形象。

sentences.en: So learn from the lady who was in a sort of nicely satiny shirt that did not look good after I'd been hustling.
sentences.zh: 所以，向那位穿着缎面衬衫、在匆忙赶路后狼狈不堪的女士吸取教训吧。

sentences.en: So, yeah,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，

sentences.en: having a think about how you might physically attend interviews and feel and look your best and not be completely overwhelmed and stressed out when you get there can be useful too.
sentences.zh: 考虑如何以最佳的身体状态参加面试，让自己感觉和外表都处于最佳状态，在到达时不会彻底崩溃和压力山大，这也是很有用的。

sentences.en: Anyway, that's a bit of an aside, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，这算是个题外话，对吧？

sentences.en: So let's take a quick pause here to take a listen to one of the book jingles and I will catch up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 那么我们在这里稍作暂停，听听其中一段播客插曲，我们在另一头见。

sentences.en: We're using today's episode to weigh up some factors involved in whether we should or would or could attend interviews in the psychology profession when you've already been offered a job somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 我们利用今天的节目来权衡一些因素，探讨当你在其他地方已经获得工作offer时，是否应该、会去或能够去参加心理学行业的面试。

sentences.en: So, of course, you have earned this right to have this interview, whether or not you were offered a reserve list place for the interview or an outright place.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，你已经赢得了参加这次面试的权利，无论你获得的是面试候补资格还是直接入选的名额。

sentences.en: It's based on your performance in the form, the application that you submitted.
sentences.zh: 这是基于你在申请表中表现出的水准。

sentences.en: It might also be linked to any assessment tests or checks that you've done too.
sentences.zh: 它也可能与你完成的任何测评或背景调查有关。

sentences.en: And when we're making decisions, sometimes it can be useful to make them as informed a decision as we can.
sentences.zh: 当我们做决定时，有时尽可能做出知情决策会很有帮助。

sentences.en: How can we know that it's going to be a good fit for us or not a good fit for us for the next one, two, three, four, five, six?
sentences.zh: 如果我们不亲自去看看、去实地考察一番，我们怎么能知道它是否适合我们，或者是否适合未来的第一年、第二年、第三年、第四年、第五年、第六年？

sentences.en: It could be many years if we haven't been and had a look and checked out for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 那可能是好多年呢。

sentences.en: And one of the things I loved about in-person interviews, certainly for the doctorate, was the chance to meet other delegates.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢线下面试（尤其是博士项目面试）的一个原因，就是有机会结识其他候选人。

sentences.en: So, if there's going to be a couple of people employed at the same time, for example, when I worked for Boots in Milton Keynes when I was 16, 17, 18,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果同时会录用好几个人，例如，我16、17、18岁时曾在米尔顿凯恩斯的博姿（Boots）工作，

sentences.en: and a little bit older than that as well,
sentences.zh: 比那还要大一点的时候也是如此，

sentences.en: we had a group interview and being able to meet people that eventually ended up being my colleagues was wonderful, really part of a bonding experience.
sentences.zh: 我们当时进行的是群面，能够结识那些最终成为我同事的人真是太棒了，这确实是一种凝聚人心的经历。

sentences.en: And when I had my doctorate in clinical psychology interviews, meeting people that would be potentially part of my cohort.
sentences.zh: 当我参加临床心理学博士面试时，遇到了未来可能会成为我同届同学的人。

sentences.en: In fact, people that I met, I certainly think I met two people on my cohort for the first time at our interview day.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我确实在面试当天第一次遇到了我同届的两个人。

sentences.en: So, it's a really nice chance to check out the other people, see what you think, and whether you feel like you might want to be part of their cohort,
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个非常好的机会，可以去观察其他人，看看你的想法，以及你是否觉得自己想成为他们同届的一员，

sentences.en: because that's clearly the type of candidate that that particular role attracts.
sentences.zh: 因为那显然就是那个特定职位所吸引的候选人类型。

sentences.en: Do you get a good feel about the other candidates?
sentences.zh: 你对其他候选人有什么好感吗？

sentences.en: And whilst, of course, when we're looking at selection days that might run over multiple weeks,
sentences.zh: 当然，当我们看到可能会持续好几周的选拔日时，

sentences.en: we can't necessarily know that we would be meeting our future colleagues or that we are all going to be the same across all of the interview days.
sentences.zh: 我们不一定能知道自己会遇到未来的同事，或者我们在所有的面试日里表现都会完全相同。

sentences.en: I think it does give you a very nice feel for how it might be if you were working in that role.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，它确实能让你对在这类职位上工作会有什么样体验产生非常直观的感受。

sentences.en: So, if you are trying to deliberate between, should I?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你正在纠结：“我该去吗？”

sentences.en: What does it say about me if I do go when I've already had this offer?
sentences.zh: “如果我已经拿到了这个offer，我还要去的话，别人会怎么看我？”

sentences.en: Then to you, I would say, it just says you're a human and that you are allowed to do what you've been offered the opportunity to do.
sentences.zh: 那么我要对你说的是：这只能说明你是个凡人，而且你有权去做你已经被赋予机会去做的事。

sentences.en: You're also allowed to not go if you choose that you want the chaos to end and you want to take control.
sentences.zh: 如果你选择结束这种混乱并想自己掌握主动权，你同样有权选择不去。

sentences.en: But there might be reasons that you're wanting to attend the interviews, because actually that course or job is going to be a better fit for you personally, geographically,
sentences.zh: 但你可能还是想去参加面试，因为实际上该课程或工作在个人发展、地理位置上可能更适合你，

sentences.en: maybe even the style of the work or maybe even the supervisor that you might be getting to work with might also be factors that you're considering.
sentences.zh: 甚至工作风格，或者你将与之共事的导师，也可能是你正在考虑的因素。

sentences.en: Maybe you have people that you need to support in your life and that this particular job role or training place is going to suit your needs better.
sentences.zh: 也许你生活中有需要照顾的人，而这个特定的职位或培训名额能更好地满足你的需求。

sentences.en: For example, maybe you are a parent and you're aware that actually this course or employer is particularly good at treating parents humanely
sentences.zh: 例如，也许你是一位父母，你知道实际上这个课程或雇主在人性化对待父母方面特别在行，

sentences.en: and so that they can optimally parent their children as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 从而使他们能够尽可能以最佳方式抚养孩子。

sentences.en: And in this day and age of social media, you might find that actually networking is a really nice opportunity as well.
sentences.zh: 在这个社交媒体的时代，你可能会发现建立人脉其实也是一个非常棒的机会。

sentences.en: So if you meet someone at an in-person or even a Zoom interview, for that matter, and you really feel like you click, then you might want to add each other on socials
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你在线下或甚至是通过Zoom面试时遇到了某人，并且你真的觉得你们很合拍，那么你可能会想在社交软件上加对方为好友，

sentences.en: and you might well be really useful supports for each other for this next stage of your career or maybe even as a lifelong friendship.
sentences.zh: 你们很可能会成为彼此职业生涯下一阶段的坚实后盾，甚至结下终生的友谊。

sentences.en: You never know where it's going to go.
sentences.zh: 你永远不知道未来会怎样。

sentences.en: And that's been a really nice part of the aspiring psychologist membership as well is that the members are so supportive of one another.
sentences.zh: 这也是“有志心理学家会员计划”中非常美好的一部分，会员们都非常支持彼此。

sentences.en: And as people have been getting interview dates and even place offers for the doctorate in clinical psychology, people are genuinely thrilled for one another.
sentences.zh: 随着大家陆续拿到临床心理学博士项目的面试日期甚至录取通知，大家都是真心实意地为彼此感到高兴。

sentences.en: And they're not only thanking me, but thanking the supportive nature of the group and feeling like they've got everybody rooting for them on their side.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅感谢我，还感谢这个群体充满支持的氛围，并觉得自己拥有了所有人坚定的支持。

sentences.en: So if you feel like this industry of ours is making you feel a bit lonely or making you feel like others are, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你觉得我们的这个行业让你感到有点孤独，或者让你觉得其他人，你知道的，

sentences.en: wanting to hack you down so that they can have your place,
sentences.zh: 为了抢占你的名额而想要把你拉下马，

sentences.en: then it might be that you want to consider coming on board to the aspiring psychologist membership.
sentences.zh: 那么你可能需要考虑加入有志心理学家会员计划。

sentences.en: And there will be links in the show notes to that, but you can also check out details in any of my socials.
sentences.zh: 节目文稿中会有相关链接，你也可以在我的任何社交媒体主页上查看详情。

sentences.en: And if you're on YouTube, there will be a link in the description and on the screen right now too.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，简介中以及此时的屏幕上也会有一个链接。

sentences.en: And as humans, we, you know, we are curious creatures and we like to feel that we are right in our decision.
sentences.zh: 作为人类，你知道的，我们是好奇的生物，我们喜欢觉得自己的决定是正确的。

sentences.en: And so it might be that you're feeling like job offer A or course offer A is totally going to be a bit of you, but we can't know what we don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可能会觉得工作offer A或课程offer A完全是你的菜，但未知的领域我们无从知晓。

sentences.en: We might be pleasantly surprised by what we see, hear, feel and experience at this other interview.
sentences.zh: 我们在另一场面试中所看到、听到、感受到和体验到的东西，或许会让我们感到惊喜。

sentences.en: And so you can give yourself permission to be curious.
sentences.zh: 因此，你可以允许自己保持好奇心。

sentences.en: And whilst, of course, I know it might be really anxiety provoking and sad making for somebody who's not getting an interview this year,
sentences.zh: 虽然我知道，对于今年没有拿到面试机会的人来说，这可能会引发极大的焦虑和悲伤，

sentences.en: I firmly believe that it's a really nice position to be in when you're getting more than one interview offer in a year so that you do get that chance to make a choice.
sentences.zh: 但我坚信，一年内能收到多个面试邀请其实是一个非常棒的处境，因为这样你才真正拥有了选择的机会。

sentences.en: And so that it's indicating that not just one course thinks you're ready, that other courses or jobs also think you're ready and you've got something worthwhile to bring.
sentences.zh: 这表明不仅只有一门课程认为你准备好了，其他课程或工作也认为你准备好了，并且你具备有价值的东西可以带来。

sentences.en: It's not to say at all that if you're not getting interviews that you don't have something worthwhile to bring.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是说如果你没有拿到面试，就说明你没有什么有价值的东西可带给别人。

sentences.en: But I honestly, and I've said before, that I felt when my time was right.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，我以前也说过，当属于我的时机到来时，我深有体会。

sentences.en: My form felt genuine.
sentences.zh: 我的申请表感觉很真实。

sentences.en: It felt like a bit of me.
sentences.zh: 它感觉非常契合自我。

sentences.en: It felt like I was being my genuine self.
sentences.zh: 它让我觉得自己在展现真实的我。

sentences.en: And I was then offered three interviews.
sentences.zh: 然后我就拿到了三个面试邀请。

sentences.en: And it just felt like it was my time.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，时机到了。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, maybe think if you're not getting outright interviews or if you're still on the waiting list, if you've learned since this podcast was released,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你没有直接拿到面试邀请，或者如果自从本期播客发布以来你得知自己今年没有拿到所申请的工作或课程的面试邀请，

sentences.en: that you're not being offered interviews this year or for the job that you've applied for.
sentences.zh: 不妨思考一下如何利用接下来的几个月来进一步提升你的技能、能力、反思和见解，

sentences.en: Think about how you can use these next few months to further and advance your skills, your abilities, your reflections, your insights,
sentences.zh: 并弥补你简历中的任何弱点或空白。

sentences.en: and to strengthen any weaknesses or bits that you've got gaps in your CV for.
sentences.zh: 当然，你可能会觉得某门特定的课程或工作更符合你的目标、优先级，以及你在心理学行业中认为激动人心、重要且有价值的事情。

sentences.en: You might, of course, feel that one particular course or job aligns more with your goals or your priorities and the things that you see as exciting and important
sentences.zh: 也许你对在某个课程或组织中的某位学术教员指导下开展研究有着特别的兴趣。

sentences.en: and worthwhile in the psychology profession.
sentences.zh: 无论你出于什么原因将那门课程或那份工作放进你的求职篮并申请它，它都是有效且重要的。

sentences.en: It might be that you have a particular interest in doing research under one of the academic staff in a particular course or organisation.
sentences.zh: 你完全有权去尝试并做出决定。

sentences.en: Whatever reason you've picked to put that course or that job into your job basket and to apply for it is valid and important.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果其他人拥有多次面试机会然后进行挑选，

sentences.en: And you're allowed to have a shot at that and make your mind up.
sentences.zh: 这对于那些在真正名额（而不仅仅是面试）的候补名单上的人来说，当然也是有益的。

sentences.en: And of course, if other people do have multiple interviews and then they all get to choose,
sentences.zh: 老实说，当人们接到电话或收到电子邮件通知他们获得候补名额时，我真想当个隐形人去旁观这一切。

sentences.en: it's, of course, useful for those on the reserve list for actual places, not just interviews.
sentences.zh: 我曾拒绝过一个名额去接受另一个。

sentences.en: And honestly, I would love to be a fly on the wall when people get the phone call or the email to offer them reserve list places.
sentences.zh: 只要一想到你可能改变了某人的人生，你知道的，并且改变了他们的职业轨迹，

sentences.en: I turned down one place to accept another.
sentences.zh: 并知道他们为自己、也可能与身边的家人和支持网络一起感受和体验到的庆祝与喜悦，

sentences.en: And yeah, just knowing that you've potentially changed someone's life and, you know, and altered their career trajectory
sentences.zh: 这一切都太不可思议了。

sentences.en: and knowing the celebration and the joy that they'll be feeling and experiencing for themselves, but also likely with their family and their support networks around them.
sentences.zh: 昨天我收到了一位会员的语音消息，告诉我他们被某个课程录取了。

sentences.en: So incredible.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我在回复语音时感动得落泪了，因为这真的很重要。

sentences.en: And yesterday I had a voice note from one of my members telling me that they had been offered a place on a course.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: And honestly, I dissolved into tears as I was leaving a voice note in response because it really does matter.
sentences.zh: 当人们听到好消息并收到“是的，你被选中了”的讯息时，这种肯定实在是太美妙了。

sentences.en: It's such a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这表明他们正在正确的圈子里前行，

sentences.en: And it's so wonderfully affirming when people are getting the news and they're getting that message that, yes, they are chosen.
sentences.zh: 他们正在说正确的话，

sentences.en: They are doing, they're moving in the right circles.
sentences.zh: 并且他们将得以晋升到职业生涯的下一个阶段。

sentences.en: They're saying the right things.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我现在又想哭了。

sentences.en: And they're going to get to advance to the next stage of their career.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我拥有世界上最好的工作。

sentences.en: And honestly, I could cry again now.
sentences.zh: 谢谢所有对本播客、对书籍以及会员计划给出如此多善意评价的朋友们。

sentences.en: I just feel like I've got the best job in the world.
sentences.zh: 如果你对本集有任何疑问或想说的话，请务必让我知道。

sentences.en: And thank you for all of you who've been so kind about the podcast and about the books and the membership.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有面试可去，或者仍在等待回复，我对你的痛苦感同身受，并不会少感到一丝难过。

sentences.en: If you've got any questions or anything you'd like to say about this episode, do let me know.
sentences.zh: 我也为你们的苦恼而动容。

sentences.en: I'm not any less sad for you if you don't have interviews to go to or if you are waiting to hear back.
sentences.zh: 这就是全部内容。

sentences.en: I am moved by your distress as well.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见。

sentences.en: But I firmly believe that your time is coming and you will get there when you're ready for this next stage of your journey.
sentences.zh: 但我坚信属于你的时代终将到来，当你准备好迎接人生旅程的下一个阶段时，你自会抵达。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for listening and for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的聆听，也感谢你们成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: If you're listening to this episode when it comes out, I hope you've had a marvellous coronation weekend with all of the scones that you might choose to eat
sentences.zh: 如果你是在本期节目刚上线时收听，我希望你度过了一个美妙的加冕周末，吃到了你所有想吃的司康饼，

sentences.en: and hope the sun has shone for you.
sentences.zh: 也希望阳光曾为你普照。

sentences.en: Wishing you all of the best of luck.
sentences.zh: 祝你们一切顺利，好运相随。

sentences.en: With any interviews you might have coming up or with being offered places for interview or on a course if you're on a reserve liSt.
sentences.zh: 无论是你即将迎来的面试，还是获得面试机会，抑或是如果你在候补名单上等待课程录取。

sentences.en: I love celebrating with you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢与你们一同庆祝。

sentences.en: So do come and hook up with me on social media.
sentences.zh: 所以，欢迎在社交媒体上与我互动。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere because I love to celebrate your wins.
sentences.zh: 我全网的账号都是 Dr. Marianne Trent，因为我热爱庆祝你们的每一个胜利。

sentences.en: So keep having them.
sentences.zh: 所以，请继续创造佳绩。

sentences.en: Hold your head high.
sentences.zh: 昂首挺胸。

sentences.en: Do your brilliant best self.
sentences.zh: 展现你最出色、最耀眼的自我。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to catching up with you on the next episode which is available from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我期待在周一早上6点发布的下一期节目中与大家相聚。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist let's be your guide With this podcast that's your side you'll be on your way to the aspiring psychologist podcast
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，就让这个时刻陪伴你的播客成为你的向导，助你踏上“有志心理学家播客”的征程

sentences.en: with Dr. Marianne Trent
sentences.zh: 主讲人是玛丽安·特伦特博士

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能打破“出售时间换取金钱”的模式来赚钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，我自2019年以来一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年亲自完成了这个项目，此后也一直陪伴着两批心理学家学员走过他们的成长之路。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持大礼包，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support four group masterminds masterclasses personalised guidance a Fortnum and Mason treat and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福南梅森（Fortnum and Mason）的美味礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 点击说明栏中的奖励页面链接了解更多详情。

sentences.en: And remember you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的专属奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
